title: Wall Mount Towel Ring 6-Inch Diameter Solid Brass, Foxtrot Collection Transitional Bathroom Hardware | Polished Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Add easy-access towel storage with this wall mount towel ring made from solid brass and sized at a 6-inch diameter in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures. Designed for transitional bathroom hardware, it’s a simple way to keep hand towels organized near the sink. The round ring style fits a wide range of versatile bath accessories and coordinates with the Foxtrot collection.

Highlights:
- Polished Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean finished appearance
- Installation hardware included
- Ideal for displaying decorative towels or everyday hand towels

Specs:
- Category: Towel Rings
- Shape: Round
- Diameter: 6 inches
- Projection: 2 inches
- Overall size (L x W x H): 6 x 6 x 6 inches
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Product weight: 1.6 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Towel ring and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
